title: About Us
content: About Us Vision Digitalized treasury management system for the economic development of the country. Mission Coordinate and facilitate digitalized transformation of treasury management to assist decision making on designing, implementing, executing, monitoring and evaluating treasury functions. Core Responsibilities 01 Implement standard IT policy across Ministry of Finance departments. 02 Upskill staff in Information and Communication Technologies. 03 Design, develop, implement and maintain IT systems for efficient processes. 04 Liaise with stakeholders throughout national ICT project lifecycles. 05 Ensure strong cybersecurity and network integrity. 06 Provide up-to-date information through the treasury website. 07 Upgrade ICT infrastructure in a timely manner. 08 Deliver maintenance support for optimal ICT operations. 09 Provide ICT training opportunities for staff and interns. title: Systems
content: Our Systems Government Salary Calculator The Government Salary Calculator App 2025, developed by the Information Technology Management Department (ITMD) of the Ministry of Finance, is a comprehensive tool designed to assist public sector employees in Sri Lanka. This app enables users to accurately calculate their revised salaries based on the latest government salary scales and circulars. Visit App Letter Management System A letter management system developed by the Information Technology Management Department (ITMD) of the Ministry of Finance is a comprehensive tool designed to streamline and optimize the process of creating, sending, receiving, and tracking correspondence within an organization. It encompasses both physical and electronic correspondence. Visit App
